entities.name: Markov
entities.description: Most prestigious and possibly most widespread vampire bloodline on Innistrad.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: Founder of the Markov bloodline and the first vampire of Innistrad; once an aging human alchemist.

entities.name: Sorin
entities.description: Edgar's grandson, turned into a vampire; planeswalker spark ignited and he left the plane.

entities.name: Shilgengar
entities.description: Demon who convinced Edgar to start blood experiments.

entities.name: Marycz
entities.description: Angel trapped and exsanguinated by Edgar and his sons.

entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: Grand but ruined vampire estate left floating above Stensia by Nahiri's magic.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: Region above which Markov Manor floats.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker whose magic tore Markov Manor from its perch.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi whose corruption the surviving Markov vampires mostly avoided.

events.summary: Shilgengar convinced Edgar to begin experiments with blood during a famine.
events.quote: the demon Shilgengar convinced Edgar to start experiments with blood

events.summary: Edgar and his sons trapped the angel Marycz and exsanguinated her, creating a ritual to feed on blood.
events.quote: Markov and his sons trapped the angel Marycz in his laboratory and exsanguinated her

events.summary: Edgar turned his grandson Sorin into a vampire, igniting Sorin's planeswalker spark; Sorin left the plane.
events.quote: the trauma of the transformation caused Sorin 's planeswalker spark to ignite

events.summary: Sorin mustered the surviving Markov vampires to retake Edgar's manor.
events.quote: were mustered by Sorin to retake Edgar's manor
